modules.writeModel: Tenant/membership/grant write model; per-resource policy is always authoritative
modules.readModels: AccessDecision cache optional, never stale grant authorization
modules.gis: coordinates in partner grants cannot authorize raw GPS
modules.requiredTests: TEN-GEO-01 cross-tenant spatial query denied; TEN-DATA-01 direct child partition RLS denied

modules.writeModel: RFQ, QuoteVersion and CarrierOffer immutable snapshots
modules.readModels: RFQ pipeline and quote-search indexes; optional filtered quote list
modules.gis: pickup/delivery locations are typed references, not geo truth
modules.requiredTests: COM-DATA-01 quote acceptance unaffected by stale projection

modules.writeModel: VehicleCombination, capacity holds, position event writer
modules.readModels: vehicle_current_position, available-capacity projection, spatial nearest shortlist
modules.partitioning: vehicle_position_event RANGE(observed_at) when GPS ingestion enabled
modules.gis: Point(4326)/geography near vehicle; GiST, stale quality
modules.requiredTests: FLT-GEO-01 nearest eligible truck respects tenant and freshness; FLT-DATA-01 duplicate/late GPS

modules.readModels: filtered product/handling-unit catalog, no replica of stock ledger
modules.gis: cargo stops reference approved facility positions; not owner of global route
modules.requiredTests: CAR-DATA-01 no duplicate HU on replay; CAR-GEO-01 no fabricated storage GPS

modules.writeModel: Safety/eligibility assessment and approved operational decisions
modules.readModels: versioned compatibility lookup, explainable assessment by rule set
modules.partitioning: none, assessment audit may be candidate after measurements
modules.gis: point/polygon overlap for legal/geofence candidate only; no auto-legal approval
modules.requiredTests: CMP-GEO-01 missing jurisdiction rule => NEEDS_REVIEW; CMP-DATA-01 replay stable decision

modules.writeModel: Booking workflow/commitment, not the FleetCapacityHold itself
modules.partitioning: none; exclusivity remains indexed DB constraint
modules.gis: customer pickup/delivery refs, never direct write to route geometry
modules.requiredTests: BKG-DATA-01 stale read model cannot confirm; BKG-GEO-01 geo-near does not book

modules.partitioning: shipment event history: later RANGE(occurred_at) candidate
modules.gis: route geometry(LineString,4326); geofence arrival is provisional
modules.requiredTests: EXE-GEO-01 geofence != POD; EXE-DATA-01 event replay maintains cargo custody

modules.readModels: shipment customer timeline/ETA/watermark; indexed by tenant and Shipment
modules.partitioning: snapshot NO; archive of notices only after measurements
modules.gis: geometry must be privacy-filtered and recent; no full truck history
modules.requiredTests: TRK-GEO-01 old truck after transfer hidden; TRK-DATA-01 stale watermark labelled

modules.readModels: document checklist read model by shipment; filtered customer list
modules.gis: geo metadata optional, cannot prove signature or physical delivery
modules.requiredTests: DOC-DATA-01 no document authority from uploaded GPS

modules.writeModel: CostEstimate, CommercialCostReport, MarginReadModel, optional opaque ExternalAccountingDocRef only
modules.readModels: Versioned sell/buy/cost/margin projections with tenant/account field masks and freshness
modules.partitioning: No finance/payment table partitioning in KERUENIX; external accounting remains authoritative
modules.gis: geo only as reference for pricing/route cost, no own spatial truth
modules.requiredTests: FIN-DATA-01 delayed margin read model never invents payments, invoice or PAID; PAY-ABS-01..06

modules.writeModel: OptimizationJob and Result/RoutePlanProposal, not confirmed booking
modules.readModels: candidate vehicle proximity and schedule eligibility projection
modules.partitioning: Job history candidate only after high volume
modules.gis: PostGIS preliminary shortlist, routing provider verified travel feasibility
modules.requiredTests: OPT-GEO-01 straight-line near candidate rejected if road/legal unsafe

modules.gis: ST_DWithin to shortlist, rescue availability/legal checks mandatory
modules.requiredTests: RSC-GEO-01 replacement cargo custody verified before tracking switch

modules.writeModel: Stock ledger, ASN, location, dock and appointment
modules.readModels: occupancy, stock balance, dock availability/yard map
modules.partitioning: historical stock movements candidate, not active balance
modules.gis: valid Polygon(4326) yard/dock geofence; indoor aisle/rack local CRS
modules.requiredTests: WMS-GEO-01 boundary logic; WMS-DATA-01 legal hold blocks pickup despite projection

modules.readModels: geo coarse heatmap, backhaul discovery and privacy-filtered feed
modules.partitioning: listing events candidate only, not active listing
modules.gis: coarse regions/precision by grants, avoid exact GPS of carrier
modules.requiredTests: MKT-GEO-01 query doesn't disclose competitor raw location

modules.writeModel: RegulatorySource, jurisdiction rule and effective date/version
modules.partitioning: none, version retention by legal policy
modules.gis: spatial overlay only under approved legal source/version
modules.requiredTests: REG-GEO-01 border crossing without confirmed rule not auto-allowed

modules.readModels: aggregated tenant-specific usage and operating costs
modules.partitioning: usage event history only if measured
modules.gis: geospatial usage quota without exposure of driver PII
modules.requiredTests: SAS-DATA-01 quota flag never disables mandatory tenant security
